description: This file defines structures and functions related to automatic differentiation (autodiff) in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including the Gradient struct and differentiation utilities.

classes.name: Gradient
classes.description: Represents the gradient information and related graphs for autograd differentiation.

methods.name: differentiate
methods.description: Performs differentiation on a given computation graph to produce gradients.

methods.name: isDifferentiable
methods.description: Checks if a node or graph is differentiable.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if a value is zero.
